clients.title: Clients
clients.lead: The companies and people you work for. Every project belongs to one client.
clients.dialogLead: Only the name is required. Add the address and tax details before you send the first invoice.
clients.deleteBody: The client and its contacts are removed. A record of them stays in the account's audit log, which admins can see, until the account is deleted. A client that has projects can't be deleted; archive it instead.

empty.title: No clients yet
empty.body: Add your first client, then create projects for them.

sections.taxLead: Shown on invoices. Use the VAT, GST or other tax number the client is registered under. EU e-invoices need it, and delivery over Peppol needs the Peppol ID.

fields.name: Name
fields.currencyHint: Rates, budgets and invoices for this client's projects use this currency.
fields.countryCodeHint: Two letters, e.g. US, DE or JP.
fields.peppolSchemeHint: The four-digit code for the type of ID, e.g. 0088 for a GLN.
fields.activeHint: Archived clients are hidden when you create projects. Their projects and history are kept.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.name: Name
contacts.invoiceRecipientHint: Invoices for this client are sent to this contact.
contacts.afterCreate: Create the client first, then add contacts.
contacts.noRecipient: No contact receives invoices yet. Mark one so invoices have someone to go to.
